named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.detailAcct
named-native-query.query: SELECT acc_pk AS "pk" ,acc_et_pk AS "kind" ,acc_id AS "name" ,acc_desc AS "desc" ,acc_ccy ,acc_balance ,acc_status ,acc_usr_pk FROM esq_account JOIN esq_entity_path ON ep_pk = acc_pk WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.detailAcctForUpdate
named-native-query.query: SELECT acc_pk AS "pk" ,acc_et_pk AS "kind" ,acc_id AS "name" ,acc_desc AS "desc" ,acc_ccy ,acc_balance ,acc_status ,acc_usr_pk FROM esq_account JOIN esq_entity_path ON ep_pk = acc_pk WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FOR UPDATE

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.acctPath
named-native-query.query: SELECT ep_path FROM esq_entity_path WHERE ep_pk = CAST(:parentId AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.insertAcctPath
named-native-query.query: INSERT INTO esq_entity_path (ep_pk, ep_path) VALUES (CAST(:pk AS bigint), :path)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.insertAcct
named-native-query.query: INSERT INTO esq_account (acc_pk, acc_et_pk, acc_id, acc_desc, acc_ccy, acc_status, acc_usr_pk, acc_crl_id, acc_req_id, acc_uid) VALUES (CAST(:id AS bigint), :kind, :name, :desc, :ccy, :status, CAST(:parentId AS bigint), :correlationId, :requestId, :uid)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.deleteEntityPath
named-native-query.query: DELETE FROM esq_entity_path WHERE ep_pk = CAST(:pk AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.deleteAcct
named-native-query.query: DELETE FROM esq_account WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.updateAcct
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_account SET acc_desc = :desc ,acc_status = :status ,acc_crl_id = :correlationId ,acc_req_id = :requestId ,acc_uid = :uid WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)
